author: IGN
description: Spider-Man was a first for superheroes. Before Peter Parker was bitten by a radioactive arachnid, there had never been a cape who also had to worry about paying rent. There's a class issue at the core of Spider-Man's origins, one that has come and gone since Stan Lee and Steve Ditko first created the wall-crawler. With Spider-Man: Brand New Day, the MCU and Tom Holland version of the web-slinger have the opportunity to get back to a fundamental truth about the character... Spider-Man needs a landlord.
title: Why Spider-Man Needs A Landlord

description:
Every reveal from Marvel’s gigantic Comic-Con panel, from new movie, casting, and character announcements to what the future holds for Spider-Man and the Avengers on the road to the epic battle against Doom. The IGN team breaks down the biggest reveals from Marvel Studio’s Hall H 2026 Panel including the casting of Ghost Rider (Ryan Gosling) and the announcement of Black Panther III, with David Jonsson dawning the habit for Ryan Coogler’s third entry in the franchise. Oh and Ryan Reynolds was there in his Grey Deadpool uniform. What does that mean? We break it down.

Those might have been the biggest Marvel Comic-Con reveals, but MCU boss Kevin Feige was also on stage revealing some Spider-Man: Brand New Day clips of Spidey and The Punisher fighting the Hulk and IGN is here to break it all down and what it could mean for the Marvel Cinematic Universe moving forward.

For all the the biggest SDCC announcements and everything Marvel, stay tuned to IGN

description:
Based on the blockbuster novel by New York Times bestselling author Blake Crouch, and created by Crouch, who also serves as showrunner, “Dark Matter” is led by stars and executive producers Golden Globe nominee Joel Edgerton and Academy Award-winner Jennifer Connelly. The 10-episode second season premieres globally on Friday, August 28, 2026 on Apple TV with the first episode, followed by one new episode every Friday through October 30, 2026. 
Hailed as one of the best sci-fi novels and celebrating the 10th anniversary of its release this year, “Dark Matter” is a story about the road not taken. In season one, the series followed Jason Dessen (Edgerton), a physicist, professor and family man who — one night while walking home on the streets of Chicago — is abducted into an alternate version of his life.
